1, 1 conj. and (BH 1), used mostly as in Heb., except that there is no Tconsecutive';--and, connecting
both words (Dn 2:5) and sentences (ib.). When three or more words are connected together, 1 may
connect them all (Dn 2:6, 2:10, 4:34, 5:18), or only the two last (2:17, 3:4, 4:4, Ezr 6:9), or the three
last (Dn 2:37 3:21), or be omitted altogether (2:27, 5:11, cf. 3:2, Ezr 4:9). ] also connects vbs., in
